questions.text: You will hear a brother and sister talking about a school trip to a museum. How does the boy feel about it?

questions.explanation: 原文: 'Much better, luckily. When I hurt it the other day, I thought I wouldn't be able to go on this trip.' 解析: 男孩说他受伤了，但幸运的是现在好多了，暗示他很庆幸能去博物馆，所以他感到自信会玩得开心。
